These are the exact sorts of puzzles @vicky.science and I gravitate towards, so we're excited to play more of it!

"Colorbound" by @panpipestudio.bsky.social is a cozy little puzzle game about painting. I appreciated its sense of place and simple yet engaging puzzles. There's also a heavy story element which ties everything together. It reminded me of Carto, which is about as high of praise as I can muster.

"The Artisan of Glimmith" is a chill, beautiful game about building stained glass windows within increasingly stringent guidelines. It's equal parts chill and challenging and they did a great job layering in complexity in the form of new rules. There's a _lot_ of it but I'm excited to play more
